user_instruction: 不需要一直盯着项目进程 太浪费token了 只负责一小时一次的分析
analysis_scope: One bounded read of latest authoritative summary, actual status, latest resource sample and new stage/error evidence; analyze changes and next dependency, then end the turn. No repeated waiting, no full log/table rereads, no extra EDA or hot edits.
reporting: One concise hourly analysis when invoked; user explicitly requested this cadence. Mark unchanged state briefly; no rapid intermediate progress pings.

automatic_scheduler.reason: No local/thread automation_update or equivalent scheduling tool exposed. Page-controller automation cannot access this local project and is not an applicable substitute.

user_manual_request_exception: If the user asks a new question before the next scheduled analysis, answer that explicit request.
